tim_customer: Hey @support — hitting 400 from POST /v1/rerank on our staging deploy. Quick error body: 
```
{
  "error": "Bad Request",
  "message": "invalid request payload"
}
```
Can someone help me debug? We only changed client serialization recently.

alex_support: Sorry — can you paste the request body (or a minimal repro curl)? Also the exact response headers if possible.

tim_customer: Thanks. Here's the exact curl we used (redacted token):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"batch":{"items":[{"id":null,"query":"","candidates":[{"id":null,"text":""}]}]}}'
```
We recently started wrapping payloads in a top-level "batch" because our SDK does some envelope magic. This used to work with another endpoint.

alex_support: Ok that helps. Two things jump out:
1) The API expects top-level `items` (array). Wrapping in `batch` will be treated as an unexpected object key and triggers a schema validation 400.
2) Within each item and candidate, `id` must be a string and `text` must be non-empty. Null/empty strings can cause validation failures or be rejected by the rerank model preprocessing.

Can you try sending a minimal payload without the wrapper and with string ids? Example repro that should succeed (replace ids/text):
```
{
  "items": [
    {
      "id": "req-1",
      "query": "How to reset password?",
      "candidates": [
        {"id": "c1", "text": "Click forgot password on sign-in"},
        {"id": "c2", "text": "Contact support"}
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```
If you still get 400, paste the raw request headers and response body.

tim_customer: Trying now... quick follow-up — the client SDK used JSON.stringify on the whole envelope but also replaced empty strings with null for legacy reasons. So we ended up with empty text + null ids. I'll patch that first.

ashley_eng: FYI from the runtime side: we do guardrails in the schema layer that return generic 400 for unexpected shapes (unknown top-level keys) and a separate 400 when required fields are missing or wrong type. We should probably return a clearer validation message for `id` type and empty `text` in rerank specifically. Filing a follow-up to improve error messages so customers can fix faster. :+1:

service-bot: Incident Log created: INC-20231221-0925 — "rerank: ambiguous 400 for envelope vs missing fields" (assigned to eng-ml)

alex_support: Thanks for the quick repro. After your patch to stop wrapping with `batch` and ensure string ids, did you get a success or a different error?

tim_customer: Patch worked — rerank returns 200 now and scores look sane. Root cause was the wrapper + null ids. Appreciate the guidance, especially the corrected payload example. Closing on our side.

alex_support: Great — marking this thread resolved. If you want, we can add a short note in the SDK docs about not wrapping payloads and ensuring string ids for rerank requests.

tim_customer: Yes please — a docs note would avoid others hitting this. Thanks!
